name: permission-toggle
scenario: Add a single boolean permission toggle to the admin settings page for the whole tenant, gating one security-sensitive code path with no existing analogous toggle to model it after.
signal_summary: Small surface area (one flag, one gated path) but a novel security-sensitive decision with no prior pattern to copy.
expect_reason: Small enough to stay a single phase, but the lack of a precedent means it stays COMPLEX rather than dropping to STANDARD — size and complexity are orthogonal here.
